scientific_role: prospective held-out-transition protocol within the already studied SDP.81 system

sealed_endpoint.member_sha256_boundary: hashing the member requires opening its payload and is deferred until the complete pre-pixel gate passes

hard_pre_pixel_requirements: archive hash and exact member inventory pass without extracting the member
four registered q1 paths and positive continuum incidence remain source-valid
parent-path physical gate passes all seven requirements under one source-owned common post-body action
fixed-key or responsive-lift transfer semantics are frozen before endpoint access
four contractive transfers and every three-path leave-one-out fold are identifiable
the four ordinary smooth-lens plus aperture functionals are frozen independently of parent transfer, and the separable-source and spatial-spectral standard-physics controls are retained

the one-zone radiative rank obstruction is enforced and any five-mode terminal registration supplies a nondegenerate multi-component line model plus a source-owned ordered conditional gas functional whose physical H_xi and B_xiZ derive a full-rank parent/body-to-gas bridge without upstream backreaction; the CO(5-4)/CO(8-7) ratio alone may not be used to declare a channel opacity profile because source function, excitation, filling and differential magnification remain degenerate; P6 reflection or two-component label symmetry alone may not be claimed to select that bridge; bridge provenance must be either a source-owned direct conditional cross derivative or a gauge-quotiented environmental mediator with source-owned D_Ze and B_xi,e and an explicit no-direct-coupling certificate; the G4D relative-coframe specialization additionally requires an occupied G4D row, a source-owned I_ZA registration and a physical gas--metric mixed derivative; if its natural common-volume completion is used, q_A, q_V, L_0, T_0, D_C, D_A, W_R, I_ZA and B_xi,h must be source-frozen, gamma_cm must be derived as Lambda_A times the W_R Gram pairing of D_C e_V and D_A e_A rather than fitted independently, both relation images must be nonzero and nonorthogonal, both rank transversality conditions must pass, the channel-wise opacity/source-function derivative must be independently source-owned, and the exact rank-at-most-one Sherman--Morrison increment plus cancellation and terminal-null flags must be recorded before endpoint access

a source-owned parent-mode to CO(10-9) centered-log registration reproduces W=-H_Z^{-1}B_ZC, the ordered conditional gas bridge P=-H_xi^{-1}B_xiZ, and, separately for all four paths, D_ZF_i=(D_xiF_i)P and J_log,i=U_0^T diag(F_i^0)^{-1}D_ZF_i plus the composite and whitened operators; it validates source hashes and fixes the resulting simple-mode orientation and permutation
a header-only freeze fixes velocity-window and rebin rules before any FITS data-array access
a header/source-only rule fixes aperture, blank-region covariance estimator and positivity/conditioning thresholds
no CO(10-9) data-array access has occurred

endpoint_score_contract.primary: leave-one-path-out generalized least-squares prediction of one common source-mode vector
endpoint_score_contract.common_volume_completion_control: when activated, score only the source-frozen exact rank-at-most-one increment Delta R=L_0^-1 u [k_V u^* L_0^-1 T_0-gamma_cm v^*]/(1+k_V u^* L_0^-1 u), with predeclared self/mixed-cancellation and terminal-null controls
endpoint_score_contract.covariance: predeclared off-source blank-aperture covariance propagated to centered-log modes
endpoint_score_contract.failure_action: demote the tested common-action/registration packet; do not fit a replacement on CO(10-9)

claim_boundary: Prospective only with respect to the repository-unopened SDP.81 CO(10-9) transition, not an independent-source replication. A scored result tests one pre-frozen common-action transfer and terminal registration on a held-out tracer through the same lens geometry. It cannot by itself establish the parent action, Nature occupation, universal parent loss, observer-time distortion, or a dark-sector replacement. Any CO(10-9) pixel access before the complete source gate passes demotes the result to retrospective diagnostic status.
